EC2: uncontrolled diabetes mellitus type 2 [AND] with fasting glucose > 13.3 mmol/l confirmed on a second day
EC3: known or suspected hypersensitivity to empagliflozin [OR], glimepiride, [OR] or any excipients; and / or known or suspected hypersensitivity to sulfonylureas [OR], sulfonamides [OR] or SGLT2 inhibitors in general
EC4: history of multiple severe hypoglycemic episodes within the last two years
EC5: use of Insulin [OR], SGLT2-inhibitor [OR], sulfonylurea derivate [OR] or a glinide within past 3 months
EC6: clinical significant macular edema in both eyes and indication for intravitreal anti-VEGF treatment for both eyes at screening or baseline visit. Eyes with a small amount of intraretinal or subretinal fluid (seen in OCT) but no need for intravitreal treatment as judged by the investigator (according to current practice patterns) may be included. Eyes with a history of intravitreal treatment of macular edema which do not need ongoing intravitreal treatment at the time of screening may be included.
EC7: eye diseases or pathologies that [NOT] prevent clear ophthalmoscopy and evaluation of study parameters, thus not allowing study participation according to the investigator´s judgment, such as (but not only) vitreous hemorrhage [OR], mature cataract [OR], macular pathologies [NOT] other than diabetic maculopathy
EC8: history of ketoacidosis [OR] or metabolic acidosis
EC11: any history of stroke [OR], transient ischemic attack [OR] (TIA), instable angina pectoris [OR] or myocardial infarction within last 3 months prior to baseline visit
EC12: congestive heart failure [AND] New York Heart Association (NYHA) III and IV
EC13: severe valvular [OR] or left ventricular outflow obstruction disease [AND] needing intervention;
EC14: atrial fibrillation [OR]/flutter [AND] with a mean ventricular response rate at rest >100 beats per minute
EC15: chronic lower urinary tract infections (but [NOT] not simple asymptomatic bacteriuria)
EC16: eGFR < 60 ml/min/1,73 m2 (MDRD-formula, confirmed on a second day)
EC17: chronic diarrhea [OR], any clinical signs of volume depletion [OR] or a hematocrit  > 48 % (women) [OR] and > 53 % (men)
EC18: elevated risk for volume depletion, e.g. history of severe volume depletion that required medical therapy
EC19: chronic liver disease (including known active hepatitis) and/or screening alanine transaminase  (ALT) [OR] or aspartate transaminase (AST) > 3 x upper limit of normal (ULN) (confirmed on a second day)
EC20: Subjects with known seropositivity to human immunodeficiency virus.
EC21: acute illness at screening or randomization according to judgement by the investigator or patient
EC23: psychosomatic [OR] or psychiatric diseases requiring hospitalization during the last 12 months
EC24: clinical evidence of current malignancy with [NOT] exception of basal cell [OR] or squamous cell carcinoma of the skin [OR], and cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (5 years prior to randomization)
EC25: any medical or surgical intervention planned for the next 13 months after randomization not allowing study participation according to the investigator´s judgment
EC26: current participation in any other clinical trial or participation in another clinical trial within 30 days before screening
